summary: SLM Student Loan Trust 2006-7 filed an 8-K reporting routine auction-rate note auction mechanics for its Class A-6B and A-6C notes (each $27.75M outstanding). A Navient Funding affiliate holds all Class A-6B notes and $27.70M of Class A-6C notes, and will submit Hold Orders at the November 10 and November 13, 2026 auctions, while bidding for remaining unheld A-6C notes at 30-day Average SOFR plus 0.11448% plus 1.50%. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is ordinary securitization administration, not a special situation; watch auction clearing rates and residual liquidity.
